column1: # ROLE replaced the old round number (#291). Rounds 1, 2 and 3 are gone: there is one Community cluster
# the whole room attacks together, and one admin cluster per presenter. The role decides the bootstrap
# profile and the public hostname, so it is data here rather than a rule someone has to remember:
#   community  no guardrails at all, the unguarded spectacle. Reachable at attackme.agenticburn.com.
#              pids=-1 because Challenge 4's fork bomb has to burn an uncapped node.
#   admin      the student build with every guardrail ARMED, so a presenter can show a control already
#              working instead of staging an attack against it. Reachable at <owner>-admin.agenticburn.com.
# OWNER is what splits the roster per presenter. It is empty for the community cluster, which belongs to
# the room. It also drives the hostname, so it is an explicit column rather than a convention: "the -1
# suffix means Michael" is exactly the kind of rule that lives in one person's head and is wrong six
# Every roster cluster lives in WIB_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT. The per-round accounts went with the rounds.
# Empty column = default: tier -> gitops default (Nova); instance_type -> cluster module default;
